review_candidates.title: Real Estate Sales
review_candidates.description: Company Description Uptown October Developments is a pioneering organization in Egypt’s real estate sector, known for flexible design principles and custom home solutions tailored to individual client needs. The company focuses on delivering high-quality, efficient projects that support sustainable urban communities. Its services cover the full real estate lifecycle, including land management, construction, and leasing. Team members join a growing, innovation-driven environment that values customer-centric design and long-term community impact. Role Description The Real Estate Sales role is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo, Egypt. The role involves prospecting and qualifying leads, presenting available properties, and guiding clients through viewings, negotiations, and closing processes. Responsibilities include maintaining up-to-date knowledge of the local market, property inventory, pricing, and relevant regulations, as well as preparing sales documentation and contracts in coordination with internal teams. The Real Estate Sales professional will provide responsive customer service, follow up on inquiries, and build long-term client relationships to support sales targets and overall business growth. Collaboration with marketing, leasing, and development teams is expected to ensure consistent messaging and a smooth client experience. Qualifications Possession of a valid Real Estate License and solid knowledge of Real Estate regulations and practices. Demonstrated Sales skills with experience in closing deals and meeting or exceeding sales targets. Strong Customer Service capabilities, including active listening, empathy, and professional communication. Understanding of Real Property concepts and the ability to explain property features, benefits, and legal considerations to clients. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; Arabic proficiency strongly preferred. Ability to work on-site in Cairo, Egypt, with strong time management, organization, and follow-up skills. Comfort with CRM tools, basic office software, and digital communication platforms. Previous experience in residential or commercial real estate sales in Egypt is an advantage. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory with strong experience.

review_candidates.title: Projects Sales Manager
review_candidates.description: IMEA (India, Middle East, Africa) Egypt LE_0170-GROME Trading Limited (L.L.C.) Employee Assignment Not remote Full Time 1 November 2026 Objective Ensure the fastest development of profitable sales growth within the market in all channels in line with GROHE’s Mission. The primary purpose of the role is to achieve annual sales targets, drive the increase in market share within this sector and enhance the geographical presence of Grohe within the Country. Primary Responsibilities Collectively accountable for the overall delivery of the Country results and leadership of the organization. The role holder will be one of the main actors in strategic planning for this channel development. Carry out his responsibilities in delivering the Sales Mission in line with corporate objectives and KPIs. Carry out his/her responsibilities in delivering his / her Project Channel Sales Mission assigned for the country’s Market in line with Corporate Objectives and KPIs Project management write and maintain project specifications within Grohe project system. Align regularly with the Line Manager on mid and long-term strategies for the country, and ensure local implementation is in full compliance with corporate guideline. Provide high quality information and analysis in support of strategic priorities and initiatives. Identify key channels and targets in region for project business by: 1. Sub Channel A: Hospitality with the Primary Target being Hotel Architects/Designers. 2. Sub Channel B: Residential with the Primary Target being Architects & Developers. 3. Sub Channel C: Health Care with the Primary Target being Architects and Owners. 4. Sub Channel D: Commercial with the Primary Target being Architects & Developers. Forecast accurate projects sales by month, quarter, and year. Maintain professional relationship with designers and architectures in the country. Develop and maintain data base / records of all key project contacts in region as required and prepare report for senior management. Qualifications And Education Bachelor’s degree in architecture, MBA (is a plus). Fluent written and spoken English & Arabic, good command of other languages to be considered a plus. Experience 5-7 years of experience in a comparable position. Demonstrate success at working in a fast-paced, rapidly growing, highly competitive, and deadline-oriented environment whilst maintaining Grohe’s quality and reputation for excellence.
